Container.Name: Anchorr
Container.Overview: Discord bot for requesting movies and TV shows via Seerr and posting notifications when new content arrives in your Jellyfin library. After the first start, open the WebUI and connect Jellyfin, Seerr and Discord by signing in. No Jellyfin plugin, TMDB or OMDb key is needed.
Container.Requires: A running Jellyfin server and Seerr instance, plus a Discord bot token.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Stores the configuration and notification state. Required, or settings are lost on container updates.

Config.Name: Bind Host
Config.Description: Address the dashboard listens on inside the container. Keep 0.0.0.0, otherwise the WebUI is unreachable.
